searchText: How does one "read" the current Ethereum specification in the execution-specs repository? Like if I wanted to read about how the gas limit can be adjusted by block producers, where would I go to look that up? The execution specs repository seems to be divided into forks, but I don't want a diff, I want "current ruleset". cc <@243183686562873344> or <@689161464829050960>, since surely you aren't doing anything better today than answering questions about Ethereum Execution Specs. 🎅 Actually, I think I found it. I guess each folder is a full copy of the spec for that version.
